versions.changelog:
Initial release with robust multi-source news aggregation and deep analysis.

- Aggregates real-time news from 8 major sources, including Hacker News, GitHub Trending, Product Hunt, Weibo, and more.
- Supports both broad "Global Scan" and targeted keyword/unique term queries with domain-aware keyword expansion.
- New deep-fetch mode (`--deep`): extracts and analyzes main article content.
- Smart time filtering intelligently fills sparse results and clearly annotates supplementary items.
- Interactive menu and command templates for user guidance.
- Generates professionally-styled, magazine-quality reports in Simplified Chinese, exported to the `reports/` directory.
